findings.explanation: Lean proves `CHR 256 = (ARB : Nat → char) 256`. Both `CHR` and `ARB` belong to the mapped vocabulary, so this equation ties two HOL4 constants together. HOL4’s saved bijection laws allow `CHR 256` to be any character while `ARB` stays fixed. Changing that one value preserves the laws because every character’s ordinal is less than 256.
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.Prelude.String

example : HOL.CHR 256 = (HOL.ARB : Nat → HOL.char) 256 := by
  unfold HOL.CHR
  exact dif_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl 256)
findings.hol4_check: !c:char. ?f:num -> char. f 256 = c /\ (!x. f (ORD x) = x) /\ (!n. n < 256 <=> ORD (f n) = n)
